text: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Hobart? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

sections.text:
The strongest **Hobart-based shortlist** is currently **FutureAbility** and **The Quill Consultancy**. For larger or more complex projects, consider national Microsoft specialists that can deliver remotely in Tasmania, particularly **SSW**, **The Missing Link**, and **Professional Advantage**.

- **FutureAbility Pty Ltd — best local specialist**
  - Hobart-based Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio consultancy.
  - Focuses on Power Apps, automated workflows and AI agents built inside the client’s Microsoft tenant.
  - Appears particularly suitable for mid-market organisations wanting a local partner and modern automation capability.[3]

- **The Quill Consultancy — best small local option to investigate**
  - Hobart-headquartered consultancy listed among Australian Power Platform developers.
  - Its smaller reported size may suit organisations seeking direct senior-consultant access rather than a large delivery team.
  - Public evidence of its specific Power Platform project history is limited, so request case studies and Microsoft credentials before appointing it.[4]

- **SSW — best for deep Microsoft engineering expertise**
  - Has delivered Microsoft solutions for more than 1,000 clients across 15 countries.
  - Its team includes Microsoft-certified consultants, MVPs and a Microsoft Regional Director.
  - A strong choice for complex Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse or Dynamics 365 work, although it is not Hobart-based.[2]

- **The Missing Link — best for end-to-end implementation and support**
  - Delivers Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI through a structured discovery, design and build process.
  - Can integrate solutions with APIs, third-party applications and Dataverse.
  - Its 180-plus local experts and Microsoft Solutions Partner status make it better suited to larger implementations, governance and ongoing support than a very small consultancy.[1]

- **Professional Advantage — best for Microsoft ecosystem integration**
  - Provides Power Platform consulting alongside Dynamics 365, Teams, SharePoint and Power BI.
  - Identifies as a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Modern Work and a Tier 1 Cloud Solution Provider.
  - Worth considering where Power Platform is part of a broader Microsoft licensing, cloud or business-applications programme.[10]

## Recommended choice

- Choose **FutureAbility** first if local Hobart presence, Power Apps, workflow automation or Copilot Studio are the priorities.
- Shortlist **SSW** or **The Missing Link** for a large, highly integrated or technically demanding programme.
- Choose **Professional Advantage** when licensing, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform need to be managed together.
- Treat **The Quill Consultancy** as a promising local alternative, but validate its delivery track record directly.

Before selecting a partner, ask for two comparable references, named Power Platform certifications or specialisations, a proposed governance model for environments and Dataverse, and a fixed discovery phase. Microsoft also recommends using its partner directory/AppSource and filtering by capabilities, specialisations and solution designations.[7]
